label: I q.77 a.6 co. and ad 2–3 — The subject produces its proper accident insofar as it is in act
locator: I q.77 a.6 co. and ad 2–3
interpretation: Aquinas explains why the powers of the soul flow from its essence, with the soul alone receiving some powers and the composite receiving others. The body contrasts proper and extraneous accidents. Ad 2 qualifies the subject’s active causality, and ad 3 describes natural resultance without a transition.
attribution: The passage states that insofar as the subject is actual, it produces its proper accident and that insofar as it is in potency, it receives that accident, which is the premise.
